div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. lint
ruff check, ruff format --check,
mypy --strict
BLOQUE si erreur

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. test
pytest, testcontainers
--cov-fail-under=80
BLOQUE si test KO ou couverture < 80 %
artefacts : coverage.xml, JUnit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. sonar
SonarCloud, couverture transmise
sonar.qualitygate.wait=true
BLOQUE si quality gate KO

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. build-scan (matrice)
image amd64 non-root
Trivy --severity CRITICAL,HIGH
--ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1
BLOQUE si faille corrigeable
artefact : rapport SARIF

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. acceptance (une fois)
needs : build-scan des 2 services
docker compose up, /health/ready
pytest tests/acceptance
BLOQUE si un critère échoue
artefact : JUnit

if: github.ref ==
refs/heads/main
et jobs précédents verts ?
